Scan is low resolution but every item was legible; nothing unreadable. SHARED CODE: a 'Directions' block at the top of p20-c2 says the following eight (8) items (59-66) consist of Statement I and Statement II and gives the four-option Code; that code is transcribed as the options A-D of each of items 59-66 (no context field needed, since each stem is unique). Items 59-60 are on p20, 61-66 on p22. FIDELITY: the booklet prints decimals with a raised dot (37·5 in item 43), recorded as an ordinary decimal point. Item 78's quotation mark before Rashtriya is printed as a closing-style mark; recorded as a normal single quote. Item 77 prints 'associated to' as printed. Item 81 statement 1 and others transcribed verbatim. FIGURE: item 55 has a diagram of the equilateral triangle ABC (A at top, C bottom-left, B bottom-right) with arrows showing the clockwise direction of motion; options are text.
